function zfeet_shapes(OLDLEG, dx)
  dx = dx or 0
  local function P(pts) local o = {} for i,p in ipairs(pts) do o[i] = {p[1]+dx, p[2]} end return o end
  local hemF = P{{724,586},{731,585},{735,589},{738,584},{742,590},{746,585},{749,589},{752,583},{756,586},{764,585}}
  local hemR = P{{850,586},{855,586},{859,590},{862,585},{866,591},{870,586},{874,589},{878,584},{882,588},{892,586}}
  local function under(h) local pts = {} for _,p in ipairs(h) do pts[#pts+1]=p end; pts[#pts+1]={h[#h][1],640}; pts[#pts+1]={h[1][1],640}; return poly(pts) end
  ZF = {hemF=hemF, hemR=hemR, dx=dx}
  ZF.below = under(hemF) + under(hemR)
  ZF.ankF = poly(P{{739.5,584},{749.5,584},{751,591},{752,595},{740,595},{739,590}}, true)
  ZF.footF = poly(P{{740,592.5},{733,596},{725,598.6},{718,600.6},{714,602.4},{715,604},{728,604.2},{742,603.6},{752,604},{756.5,601.5},{756,597},{752,593.5}}, true)
  ZF.ragF = poly(P{{751,585},{756,585},{756.5,592},{754.5,596.5},{752.5,591}}, true)
  ZF.ankR = poly(P{{862.5,584},{872.5,584},{875,591},{876,594},{866,595},{863.5,590}}, true)
  ZF.footR = poly(P{{866,592},{876,592},{880.5,594.5},{881.5,598.5},{876,601},{866,603.4},{858,604.8},{850,605},{848,603.6},{852,601.5},{858,598.5}}, true)
  ZF.ragR = poly(P{{876,585},{882,586},{885.5,595},{883.5,599},{879.5,593}}, true)
  ZF.skin = (ZF.ankF + ZF.footF + ZF.ankR + ZF.footR) * ZF.below
  ZF.rags = (ZF.ragF + ZF.ragR) * ZF.below - ZF.skin
  ZF.rest = (OLDLEG * ZF.below) - ZF.skin - ZF.rags
end
function zfeet_lay3()
  local dx = ZF.dx
  local nz = noise{seed=1201, period=110, octaves=4, stretch={0, 5}}
  local nz2 = noise{seed=1202, period=40, octaves=3, stretch={0, 3}}
  local function depth(y) return clamp((y-485)/180,0,1) end
  work(ZF.rest, {hand="detail", tool={kind="filbert", width=3}, piles={
    {gf, function(x,y) local d = depth(y); return clamp(1-d*3.2,0,1)*1.6 + clamp(nz(x-dx,y)-0.15,0,1)*1.2*clamp(1-d*1.6,0,1) end},
    {gm, function(x,y) local d = depth(y); return clamp(1-math.abs(d-0.35)*3.2,0,1)*1.2 + clamp(nz2(x-dx,y),0,1)*0.3 end},
    {gd, function(x,y) local d = depth(y); return clamp((d-0.45)*2.4,0,1)*1.5 + clamp(-nz(x-dx,y)-0.2,0,1)*0.8*d end}},
     coverage=3.5, fill=true, clip=ZF.rest, length={4,10}, angle=0.02, seed=40001})
  local S = ZF.skin
  local function lit(x,y)
    local a = 0
    for _, d in ipairs({1.0, 2.0}) do a = a + (1 - S:at(x - 0.55*d, y - 0.83*d)) end
    return a/2
  end
  local function lower(x,y)
    local a = 0
    for _, d in ipairs({1.5, 3}) do a = a + (1 - S:at(x + 0.2*d, y + d)) end
    return a/2
  end
  local function hemdark(x,y) return clamp(1 - (y - 586)/5, 0, 1) end
  work(S, {hand="detail", tool={kind="filbert", width=2.2}, piles={
     {zs_d, 1},
     {cavity, function(x,y) return hemdark(x,y)*2.5 + lower(x,y)*1.0 + 0.4 end},
     {zs_m, function(x,y) local l = lit(x,y); return clamp(l*1.6-0.4,0,1)*1.3*(1-hemdark(x,y)) end}},
     coverage=3.5, fill=true, clip=S, length={3,6}, angle=function(x,y) return (y > 593) and 3.0 or 1.7 end, seed=40002})
  work(ZF.rags, {hand="detail", tool={kind="filbert", width=2}, piles={{ztrou2,1},{legdk,0.4}}, coverage=3.5, fill=true, clip=ZF.rags, length={3,8}, angle=1.6, seed=40003})
end
zfeet_shapes(ZP.legs:grow(2), 0)
print(ZF.rest:area(), ZF.skin:area(), ZF.rags:area())
zfeet_lay3()

-- a rock: flat-bottomed, lit on the side toward the moon (mx,my direction)
function rock(cx, cy, w, h, seed, mdx, mdy)
  math.randomseed(seed)
  local pts = {}
  local n = 9
  for i = 0, n do
    local a = math.pi + i/n*math.pi        -- from left, over the top, to the right
    local r = 1 + (math.random()-0.5)*0.35
    pts[#pts+1] = {cx + math.cos(a)*w/2*r, cy + math.sin(a)*h*r}
  end
  pts[#pts+1] = {cx + w/2*0.9, cy + h*0.12}
  pts[#pts+1] = {cx - w/2*0.9, cy + h*0.15}
  local m = poly(pts, true)
  local function lit(x,y)
    local a = 0
    for _, d in ipairs({1, 2, 3.5}) do a = a + (1 - m:at(x + mdx*d, y + mdy*d)) end
    return a/3
  end
  work(m, {hand="detail", tool={kind="filbert", width=math.max(2, w*0.18)}, piles={
     {stone_dd, function(x,y) return 0.6 + smoothstep(cy - h*0.3, cy + h*0.1, y)*1.2 end},
     {stone_d, 0.8},
     {stone_m, function(x,y) return clamp(lit(x,y)*1.8 - 0.3, 0, 1)*1.6 end}},
     coverage=3.5, fill=true, clip=m, length={2,6}, angle=0.2, seed=seed})
  -- the crest catching the moon: a short hairline on the lit shoulder
  local r = brush{kind="round", width=1.3, point=0.85}
  r:load(stone_l, 0.45)
  local best = {}
  for i = 1, #pts - 2 do
    local p = pts[i]
    local ux, uy = p[1]-cx, p[2]-cy
    if (ux*mdx + uy*mdy) > 0 then best[#best+1] = {p[1] - mdx*0.8, p[2] - mdy*0.8 + 0.6} end
  end
  if #best >= 2 then
    local g = {}
    for i, p in ipairs(best) do g[#g+1] = {p[1], p[2], (i == 1 or i == #best) and 0.1 or 0.45} end
    r:gesture(g, {clip=m:grow(0.5)})
  end
  -- a contact shadow on the sand, falling down-left (away from the moon)
  local sh = (ellipse(cx - w*0.25, cy + h*0.22, w*0.62, h*0.3) - m):blur(1)
  work(sh, {hand="detail", tool={kind="round", width=2}, pile=shad, coverage=2.5, fill=true, clip=sh, length={3,7}, angle=0.05, seed=seed+1})
  return m
end
-- a sage clump: dark mass at the base, twiggy strokes up and out, a few dim moonlit tips
function sagebrush(cx, cy, w, h, seed, mdx, mdy, old)
  math.randomseed(seed)
  local base = ellipse(cx, cy - h*0.3, w*0.42, h*0.35):roughen(w*0.08, w*0.2, seed)
  if old then base = base + old end
  stipple(base, {pile=sage_d, width=math.max(2, w*0.09), coverage=3.5, cluster=0.3, pressure={0.5,0.9}, seed=seed})
  local r = brush{kind="round", width=math.max(1.6, w*0.035), point=0.85}
  local n = math.floor(w*0.55)
  for i = 1, n do
    local t = (i - 0.5)/n
    local a = -math.pi/2 + (t - 0.5)*2.3 + (math.random()-0.5)*0.3
    local L = h*(0.75 + math.random()*0.5) * (1 - 0.35*math.abs(t-0.5)*2)
    local x0 = cx + (t-0.5)*w*0.35
    local y0 = cy - h*0.05
    local x1, y1 = x0 + math.cos(a)*L*0.55, y0 + math.sin(a)*L*0.55
    local x2, y2 = x0 + math.cos(a + (math.random()-0.5)*0.4)*L, y0 + math.sin(a)*L
    r:load(sage_d, 0.55)
    r:gesture({{x0, y0, 0.8},{x1, y1, 0.55},{x2, y2, 0.0}}, {wobble=0.4})
  end
  -- moonlit tips on the side toward the moon
  r:load(sage_m, 0.4)
  for i = 1, math.floor(w*0.18) do
    local t = 0.45 + math.random()*0.55
    local a = -math.pi/2 + (t - 0.5)*2.0
    local L = h*(0.6 + math.random()*0.4)
    local x0 = cx + (t-0.5)*w*0.5 + math.cos(a)*L*0.45
    local y0 = cy - h*0.1 + math.sin(a)*L*0.45
    r:gesture({{x0, y0, 0.45},{x0 + math.cos(a)*L*0.4, y0 + math.sin(a)*L*0.4, 0.0}}, {wobble=0.3})
  end
  -- its shadow on the sand, down-left
  local sh = (ellipse(cx - w*0.2, cy + h*0.05, w*0.55, h*0.16)):blur(1.5) * below({{0, cy - h*0.1},{1000, cy - h*0.1}})
  work(sh, {hand="detail", tool={kind="round", width=2.2}, pile=shad, coverage=2, fill=true, clip=sh, length={3,8}, angle=0.05, seed=seed+2})
end

function tuft(cx, cy, w, h, seed, mdx, mdy, old)
  math.randomseed(seed)
  local sh = (ellipse(cx - w*0.2, cy + h*0.05, w*0.48, h*0.12)):blur(1.5) * below({{0, cy - h*0.1},{1000, cy - h*0.1}})
  work(sh, {hand="detail", tool={kind="round", width=2.2}, pile=gshad, coverage=2, fill=true, clip=sh, length={3,8}, angle=0.05, seed=seed+2})
  local base = ellipse(cx, cy - h*0.15, w*0.3, h*0.2):roughen(w*0.06, w*0.12, seed)
  if old then base = base + old end
  stipple(base, {pile=sage_d, width=math.max(2, w*0.07), coverage=3.5, cluster=0.3, pressure={0.5,0.9}, seed=seed})
  local r = brush{kind="round", width=math.max(1.5, w*0.028), point=0.9}
  local n = math.floor(w*0.8)
  local blades = {}
  for i = 1, n do
    local t = math.random()
    local spread = (t - 0.5)*2              -- -1 left .. 1 right
    local a = -math.pi/2 + spread*1.15 + (math.random()-0.5)*0.5
    local L = h*(0.5 + math.random()*0.75) * (1 - 0.35*math.abs(spread))
    local x0 = cx + spread*w*0.2 + (math.random()-0.5)*w*0.1
    local y0 = cy - h*0.02
    local droop = spread*0.5 + (math.random()-0.5)*0.3       -- outer blades arch over
    local x1, y1 = x0 + math.cos(a)*L*0.5, y0 + math.sin(a)*L*0.5
    local a2 = a + droop
    local x2, y2 = x1 + math.cos(a2)*L*0.5, y1 + math.sin(a2)*L*0.5 + math.abs(spread)*L*0.12
    blades[#blades+1] = {x0,y0,x1,y1,x2,y2, clamp(math.cos(a)*mdx + math.sin(a)*mdy, 0, 1)}
  end
  -- dark blades first, lighter (moon-side) blades on top
  table.sort(blades, function(p, q) return p[7] < q[7] end)
  for _, b in ipairs(blades) do
    local p = (b[7] > 0.75 and math.random() < 0.6 and sage_g) or (b[7] > 0.4 and sage_dg) or sage_d
    r:load(p, 0.6)
    r:gesture({{b[1], b[2], 0.75},{b[3], b[4], 0.5},{b[5], b[6], 0.0}}, {wobble=0.3})

end
function rock2(cx, cy, w, h, seed, mdx, mdy)
  math.randomseed(seed)
  local pts = {}
  local n = 9
  for i = 0, n do
    local a = math.pi + i/n*math.pi
    local r = 1 + (math.random()-0.5)*0.35
    pts[#pts+1] = {cx + math.cos(a)*w/2*r, cy + math.sin(a)*h*r}
  end
  pts[#pts+1] = {cx + w/2*0.9, cy + h*0.12}
  pts[#pts+1] = {cx - w/2*0.9, cy + h*0.15}
  local m = poly(pts, true)
  local sh = (ellipse(cx - w*0.25, cy + h*0.2, w*0.6, h*0.28) - m):blur(1)
  work(sh, {hand="detail", tool={kind="round", width=2}, pile=gshad, coverage=2.5, fill=true, clip=sh, length={3,7}, angle=0.05, seed=seed+1})
  local function lit(x,y)
    local a = 0
    for _, d in ipairs({1, 2, 3.5}) do a = a + (1 - m:at(x + mdx*d, y + mdy*d)) end
    return a/3
  end
  work(m, {hand="detail", tool={kind="filbert", width=math.max(2, w*0.18)}, piles={
     {stone_dd, function(x,y) return 0.6 + smoothstep(cy - h*0.3, cy + h*0.1, y)*1.2 end},
     {stone_d, 0.8},
     {stone_m, function(x,y) return clamp(lit(x,y)*1.8 - 0.3, 0, 1)*1.6 end}},
     coverage=3.5, fill=true, clip=m, length={2,6}, angle=0.2, seed=seed})
  local r = brush{kind="round", width=1.3, point=0.85}
  r:load(stone_l, 0.45)
  local best = {}
  for i = 1, #pts - 2 do
    local p = pts[i]
    if ((p[1]-cx)*mdx + (p[2]-cy)*mdy) > 0 then best[#best+1] = {p[1] - mdx*0.8, p[2] - mdy*0.8 + 0.6} end
  end
  if #best >= 2 then
    local g = {}
    for i, p in ipairs(best) do g[#g+1] = {p[1], p[2], (i == 1 or i == #best) and 0.1 or 0.45} end
    r:gesture(g, {clip=m:grow(0.5)})
  end
  return m
end

sage_g = pile{{"lead white",0.35},{"green earth",0.6},{"raw umber",0.45},{"bone black",0.25},{"Prussian blue",0.04}, name="sage_g"}
sage_dg = mix{{sage_d, 0.6}, {sage_g, 0.4}, name="sage_dg"}
sage_w = mix{{sage_d, 0.55}, {gw, 0.45}, name="sage_w"}
stone_m = mix{{stone_d, 0.6}, {stone_l, 0.4}, name="stone_m"}
stone_dd = mix{{stone_d, 0.6}, {shad, 0.4}, name="stone_dd"}
function tuft(cx, cy, w, h, seed, mdx, mdy, warm)
  math.randomseed(seed)
  warm = warm or 0
  local sh = (ellipse(cx - w*0.2, cy + h*0.05, w*0.48, h*0.12)):blur(1.5) * below({{0, cy - h*0.1},{1000, cy - h*0.1}}) - FIG2:grow(1)
  work(sh, {hand="detail", tool={kind="round", width=2.2}, pile=gshad, coverage=2, fill=true, clip=sh, length={3,8}, angle=0.05, seed=seed+2})
  local base = ellipse(cx, cy - h*0.15, w*0.3, h*0.2):roughen(w*0.06, w*0.12, seed)
  stipple(base, {pile=sage_d, width=math.max(2, w*0.07), coverage=3.5, cluster=0.3, pressure={0.5,0.9}, seed=seed})
  local r = brush{kind="round", width=math.max(1.5, w*0.028), point=0.9}
  local n = math.floor(w*0.8)
  local blades = {}
  for i = 1, n do
    local t = math.random()
    local spread = (t - 0.5)*2
    local a = -math.pi/2 + spread*1.15 + (math.random()-0.5)*0.5
    local L = h*(0.5 + math.random()*0.75) * (1 - 0.35*math.abs(spread))
    local x0 = cx + spread*w*0.2 + (math.random()-0.5)*w*0.1
    local y0 = cy - h*0.02
    local droop = spread*0.5 + (math.random()-0.5)*0.3
    local x1, y1 = x0 + math.cos(a)*L*0.5, y0 + math.sin(a)*L*0.5
    local a2 = a + droop
    local x2, y2 = x1 + math.cos(a2)*L*0.5, y1 + math.sin(a2)*L*0.5 + math.abs(spread)*L*0.12
    local up = clamp(-math.sin(a), 0, 1)
    blades[#blades+1] = {x0,y0,x1,y1,x2,y2, clamp(math.cos(a)*mdx + math.sin(a)*mdy, 0, 1), up}
  end
  table.sort(blades, function(p, q) return p[7] < q[7] end)
  for _, b in ipairs(blades) do
    local p
    if warm > 0 and b[8] > 0.85 and math.random() < warm then p = sage_w
    elseif b[7] > 0.75 and math.random() < 0.6 then p = sage_g
    elseif b[7] > 0.4 then p = sage_dg
    else p = sage_d end
    r:load(p, 0.6)
    r:gesture({{b[1], b[2], 0.75},{b[3], b[4], 0.5},{b[5], b[6], 0.0}}, {wobble=0.3})
  end
end
function rock2(cx, cy, w, h, seed, mdx, mdy)
  math.randomseed(seed)
  local pts = {}
  local n = 9
  for i = 0, n do
    local a = math.pi + i/n*math.pi
    local r = 1 + (math.random()-0.5)*0.35
    pts[#pts+1] = {cx + math.cos(a)*w/2*r, cy + math.sin(a)*h*r}
  end
  pts[#pts+1] = {cx + w/2*0.9, cy + h*0.12}
  pts[#pts+1] = {cx - w/2*0.9, cy + h*0.15}
  local m = poly(pts, true)
  local sh = (ellipse(cx - w*0.25, cy + h*0.2, w*0.6, h*0.28) - m):blur(1) - FIG2:grow(1)
  work(sh, {hand="detail", tool={kind="round", width=2}, pile=gshad, coverage=2.5, fill=true, clip=sh, length={3,7}, angle=0.05, seed=seed+1})
  local function lit(x,y)
    local a = 0
    for _, d in ipairs({1, 2, 3.5}) do a = a + (1 - m:at(x + mdx*d, y + mdy*d)) end
    return a/3
  end
  work(m, {hand="detail", tool={kind="filbert", width=math.max(2, w*0.18)}, piles={
     {stone_dd, function(x,y) return 0.6 + smoothstep(cy - h*0.3, cy + h*0.1, y)*1.2 end},
     {stone_d, 0.8},
     {stone_m, function(x,y) return clamp(lit(x,y)*1.8 - 0.3, 0, 1)*1.6 end}},
     coverage=3.5, fill=true, clip=m, length={2,6}, angle=0.2, seed=seed})
  local r = brush{kind="round", width=1.3, point=0.85}
  r:load(stone_l, 0.45)
  local best = {}
  for i = 1, #pts - 2 do
    local p = pts[i]
    if ((p[1]-cx)*mdx + (p[2]-cy)*mdy) > 0 then best[#best+1] = {p[1] - mdx*0.8, p[2] - mdy*0.8 + 0.6} end
  end
  if #best >= 2 then
    local g = {}
    for i, p in ipairs(best) do g[#g+1] = {p[1], p[2], (i == 1 or i == #best) and 0.1 or 0.45} end
    r:gesture(g, {clip=m:grow(0.5)})
  end
  return m
end

  stipple(base, {pile=sage_d, width=math.max(2, w*0.06), coverage=4, cluster=0.3, pressure={0.5,0.9}, seed=seed})

    local L = h*(0.35 + math.random()*0.55)
    local x0 = cx + spread*w*0.3
    local y0 = cy - h*(0.1 + math.random()*0.25)

    local x1, y1 = x0 + math.cos(a)*L*0.55, y0 + math.sin(a)*L*0.55
    local x2, y2 = x1 + math.cos(a2)*L*0.45, y1 + math.sin(a2)*L*0.45
    -- how much it faces the moon (up-right)
    local face = (math.cos(a)*0.6 - math.sin(a)*0.8) + spread*0.3
    blades[#blades+1] = {x0,y0,x1,y1,x2,y2, face}
  end
  table.sort(blades, function(p,q) return p[7] < q[7] end)
  for i, b in ipairs(blades) do

  for i = 1, nlit do

function bootpass(bm, opts)

function darkblades(cx, cy, w, h, seed, n, lean)
  math.randomseed(seed)
  local r = brush{kind="round", width=math.max(1.5, w*0.026), point=0.9}
  for i = 1, n do
    local spread = math.random()*2 - 1
    local a = -math.pi/2 + lean + spread*1.0 + (math.random()-0.5)*0.4
    local L = h*(0.45 + math.random()*0.6) * (1 - 0.3*math.abs(spread))
    local x0 = cx + spread*w*0.18
    local y0 = cy - h*0.02
    local a2 = a + spread*0.4 + (math.random()-0.5)*0.3
    local x1, y1 = x0 + math.cos(a)*L*0.5, y0 + math.sin(a)*L*0.5
    local x2, y2 = x1 + math.cos(a2)*L*0.5, y1 + math.sin(a2)*L*0.5
    r:load((math.random() < 0.75) and sage_d or sage_dg, 0.6)
    r:gesture({{x0, y0, 0.8},{x1, y1, 0.5},{x2, y2, 0.0}}, {wobble=0.3})

  local base = ellipse(cx, cy - h*0.1, w*0.24, h*0.14):roughen(w*0.04, w*0.1, seed)
  stipple(base, {pile=sage_d, width=math.max(2, w*0.06), coverage=3, cluster=0.3, pressure={0.5,0.9}, seed=seed})
end

## Day 188-268 sitting: summary, judgments, handoff
Changes this sitting:
- Zombie feet (see the entry above): bony bare feet under ragged trouser cuffs, toes on the ground. After the first pass a pale gap of old ground lay between the cuffs and the knee band. A knife scrape lifted the fresh pass cleanly (thick, fully open). A ztrou2/zd_mid band re-laid wet-into-wet plus a small badger blend joined the cuffs to the legs above. Reads well now.
- Foreground: the old pale speckled sage blobs and pale stones were overpainted with ground (gf/gm/gd/gw at the same depth weights, detail filbert 3, cov 3.5). New rocks rock2() (flat-bottomed polygon; stone_dd base dark at the bottom, stone_m on the moon side from mask lookups, a stone_l hairline on the lit crest, gshad cast shadow down-left) and tufts tuft() (dark stippled base + arched pointed-round blades). The tufts dried PALE silvery and read as fountain grass. An shbt scumble to darken them went down as a khaki/olive blob (see lesson 12). Fix: spirits rag with a FRESH rag per wipe, wiped back and forth (rag width 14, dip .9, pressure .85, 2 rounds), took the open blob off down to the dry ground and left the dry tufts. Then darkblades(): 40 and 22 extra dark sage_d/sage_dg blades in front. They now read as dark desert clumps with a few moonlit blades.
- Bottom-right corner below the signature: a lighter patch from earlier ground repairs, darkened with gnear (gd .7 + shad .3) body strokes, edge lost.
- Cowboy boots: repainted (boot2 + boot_m/boot_rim graded by light, cov 3.5, then boot2 lay 6). Both came out mid warm brown on the painting, where the same passes in scratch over a similar ridged mid-brown substrate went near-black (see lesson 10). Once dry, thin boot_rim hairlines along the insteps and boot_lit glints on the toe caps. Accepted: they read as leather boots catching the flash, and the warmth ties them to the glow pool.

Judgments on passages left unresolved before (inspected in detail crops this sitting):
- Cowboy's coat (fold pass, brown and mottled): ACCEPT. The crop still reads as a heavy duster hanging in folds. The mottling suits worn oilcloth, and another pass risks the veining again.
- Zombie torso (faint coat folds): ACCEPT. A dark olive mass with ribs against the shirt reads clearly at viewing distance, and it has to stay dark.
- Smoke cloud vs moon: ACCEPT. In the full view the cloud reads as lit smoke with a drifting gray edge, not a second moon.
- Sky ghost around the hat: ACCEPT. A faint lighter halo shows at the crown's left only in value mode. Lesson 7 still holds.
- Old "insect leg" ghost hairlines, zombie trouser columns: unchanged, accepted.
- NEW, accepted: the torso-shadow scumble under the zombie (ZSHT) shows a faint woven texture up close. It reads as sand texture in shadow.

Practical lessons (carry forward; rules are hypotheses):
1-9, 11: as in the day 188 handoff (night darks <=4% white; clip= when painting around; gunshot = jet + lit smoke + warm edges; small dark features as filled polygons on a dry base; thin dark rigger lines read as insect legs; sky repaints leave ghosts; medium .75-.82 glazes over textured dry paint vein; folds as weighted piles in ONE opaque pass; white-heavy glow stays open ~3 days).
4 (updated): a knife scrape (width 10, pressure 1, 4-unit crossing passes) DID lift a fresh, thick detail pass cleanly (zombie feet, day 207). It did not lift a thin fresh body pass (day 173), nor a fresh scumble-plus-body pass on the tufts (day 222). The thickness and openness of the fresh film seem to matter.
10 (seen twice now: zombie coat, cowboy boots): dark no-white passes over existing mid-brown dry paint come out notably lighter and warmer on the painting than in scratch trials. The same recipe even matched a ridged scratch substrate. Neither added medium nor lay 6 made the painting go dark. Cause unknown. Judge dark repaints on the painting itself and expect them to land a step lighter.
12 NEW: an shbt (thinner .6) scumble over pale dry blades on dark ground does not darken them selectively. It laid an opaque-looking khaki blob across the whole patch (on painting; it read olive). To push pale strokes down, paint more dark strokes in front instead.
13 NEW: a spirits rag lifts an open passage off dry paint cleanly IF you use a fresh rag per wipe and wipe back and forth (width 14, dip .9, pressure .85, 2 rounds). The same wipes with one refolded rag (load .89) smeared and left the blob. This is likely why earlier rag lifts over dry paint smeared (lesson 4).
14 NEW: when a mask is built from a polygon under a hem line, check that the polygon spans the whole x-range of what it should cover (the first zombie-foot pass missed the toes beyond the hem's end points).
Uncertain: why painting and scratch differ for darks (10).
Heart: happy. The duel still reads at a glance. The zombie now stands on bony feet in its shadow, and the foreground has a few dark sage clumps and moonlit stones without pulling the eye down. Everything was touch-dry at day 268.

content.text:
**Boot Hill, Midnight**

This is a moonlit desert nocturne. A gunslinger in a long duster fires his Colt, and the yellow-white flame bursts into a cloud of powder smoke lit from inside. That flash is the only hot color in the picture. On the right, a skull-faced zombie reaches for him with bony claws. Its head is snapped back and a dark spray flies off toward the full moon. Behind it are the crosses of Boot Hill and a blue mesa on the horizon.

**What I changed this sitting:**
- **Zombie's feet:** its legs used to end in pointed dark shapes that looked like a doll's slippers. Now bony bare feet stick out from ragged trouser cuffs, with the toes resting on the sand inside its moon shadow.
- **Foreground:** I painted out the old pale, speckled sage blobs and stones. In their place are a few dark sage clumps with some moonlit blades, and flat-bottomed rocks with a lit top edge and a shadow. They break up the empty strip at the bottom without pulling the eye down.
- **Fixing the clumps:** the new clumps first dried pale silver. My thinned dark paint went on as a khaki blob instead of darkening them. A spirits rag took the blob off cleanly, but only once I used a fresh rag for each wipe. Then I painted extra dark blades in front of the pale ones.
- **Cowboy's boots:** repainted with a thin moonlit line along the top of each foot and a warm glint from the flash on the toes.

**Old problems I looked at again and left as they are:**
- **Coat folds:** they're a bit brown and mottled, which reads as worn oilcloth.
- **Zombie's coat folds:** they're faint, but the coat needs to stay dark against the pale shirt.
- **Smoke vs. moon:** the cloud still reads as smoke, not a second moon.
- **Patch in the sky by the hat:** a faint lighter area only shows when I check the values in grayscale. Another repaint there would make it worse.
- **New, also accepted:** the shadow under the zombie has a faint woven texture up close, which passes for sand.

**Still unexplained:** dark repaints keep landing a step lighter and warmer on the painting than the same recipe does in scratch. It happened with the zombie's coat last time and with the boots this time. More oil in the paint and laying it thicker didn't change it. I accepted the boots as warm brown leather catching the flash.

The journal now has the updated lessons, including the fresh-rag-per-wipe lift and dark strokes in front of pale ones instead of a thin dark coat over them.

My heart is happy with it. The duel reads at a glance, the zombie now stands on the ground, and the night holds together. Everything was touch-dry at day 268.
